rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The presiding Chairman G. N. Seleznev tells the sitting that the President, asked by the Duma Council to present his candidate in person, proposed that the Chairman present V. S. Chernomyrdin, and reads the President's letter: under Article 111 of the Constitution 'вношу предложение о кандидатуре Черномырдина Виктора Степановича на должность Председателя Правительства Российской Федерации и прошу дать согласие на его назначение'. Earlier in the sitting deputy E. B. Mizulina says that less than a day had passed since the President's submission ('Не прошло и суток с момента внесения представления Президентом').
rows.locator: Morning session: Mizulina's remarks and the Chairman's presentation of the candidacy (before Chernomyrdin's address)

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The Chairman puts the question whether to give the President consent to appoint Viktor Stepanovich Chernomyrdin Chairman of the Government, in a secret vote; the electronic result (16:21:54) reads 314 for (69.8%), 85 against (18.9%), 3 abstentions (0.7%), 402 voting, 48 not voting, 'Результат: принято'. Chernomyrdin then thanks the deputies and speaks of what will follow 'после того как будет указ о моем назначении'.
rows.locator: Afternoon: ballot formulation, 'Результаты голосования (16 час. 21 мин. 54 сек.)', Chernomyrdin's reply
